title: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M — As AI transforms the accounting industry, Ravical aims to help firms turn individual expertise into shared knowledge …
